feats.title: Bloodhunter's Dread
feats.description: When you hit a bloodied foe, the target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Bloodseeker
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls against bloodied enemies marked by you.

feats.title: Ferocious Rebuke
feats.description: When you use the Infernal Wrath power, you can push the target up to 2 squares in addition to any damage you deal. At 11th level, increase the maximum distance to up to 3 squares. At 21st level, increase the maximum distance to up to 4 squares.

feats.title: Imperious Majesty
feats.description: When you hit a creature that has not yet acted in an encounter with an attack, it takes a penalty to attack rolls against you equal to your Main Ability until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Tail Slide
feats.description: When you shift, you can also slide an ally adjacent to your starting square 1 square.

feats.title: Hellfire Blood
feats.description: You gain a +1 racial bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls when you use a power that has the Fire or Fear keyword. At 11th level, the bonus to damage rolls increases to +2. At 21st level, the bonus to damage rolls increases to +3.

feats.title: Renewed Wrath
feats.description: Whenever you use your Second Wind or spend an Action Point, you regain the use of your Infernal Wrath.

feats.title: Hellish Defiance
feats.description: When you use Infernal Wrath, the target provokes opportunity attacks from your allies when it attacks you until the end of its next turn.

feats.title: Infernal Warrior
feats.description: When an enemy scores a critical hit against you, you can use your Infernal Wrath power even if you have already used the power this encounter.

feats.title: Unbalancing Wrath
feats.description: The target of your Infernal Wrath grants combat advantage to your allies until the end of the target’s next turn.
